canDoYue: 你識問邊條線直達中環、邊個出口最近，再增值八達通同買單程票。
canDoEn: Stay on the Island line to Central, ask which exit is closest, top up an Octopus card, and buy a single journey ticket.

dialogue.speaker: hana
dialogue.text: Which line goes to Central from this station, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 請問呢個站邊條線去中環？
dialogue.say: Which line goes to Central from this station, please?

dialogue.speaker: otto
dialogue.text: Please stay on the Island line, and it stops at Central.
dialogue.glossYue: 請留喺港島線，呢條線會停中環。
dialogue.say: Please stay on the Island line, and it stops at Central.

dialogue.speaker: hana
dialogue.text: Which exit is closest when I arrive at Central, please?
dialogue.glossYue: 我去到中環，邊個出口最近？
dialogue.say: Which exit is closest when I arrive at Central, please?

dialogue.speaker: otto
dialogue.text: Use exit A, and it is a short walk out to the street.
dialogue.glossYue: 用 A 出口，行少少就到街。
dialogue.say: Use exit A, and it is a short walk out to the street.

dialogue.speaker: hana
dialogue.text: I need to top up my Octopus card before I ride.
dialogue.glossYue: 上車之前我要增值八達通。
dialogue.say: I need to top up my Octopus card before I ride.

dialogue.speaker: otto
dialogue.text: You can top up twenty dollars at this machine by the gate.
dialogue.glossYue: 閘機旁邊部機可以增值二十蚊。
dialogue.say: You can top up twenty dollars at this machine by the gate.

dialogue.speaker: hana
dialogue.text: How much is a single journey ticket to Central station?
dialogue.glossYue: 去中環站一張單程票幾多錢？
dialogue.say: How much is a single journey ticket to Central station?

dialogue.speaker: otto
dialogue.text: That ticket is twelve dollars, and you can pay at the machine over there.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張票十二蚊，你可以喺嗰部機畀錢。
dialogue.say: That ticket is twelve dollars, and you can pay at the machine over there.
